description.value: Ryu Katsu + Ramen bar is a Japanese restaurant on Vancouver's West Broadway corridor specializing in both ramen (over a dozen broth styles including tonkotsu, miso, shio, and shoyu) and katsu breaded-cutlet sets. The menu is unusually vegan-friendly, with dedicated vegan ramen, gyoza, and katsu options clearly labelled throughout. Online ordering for quick pickup is available, making it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists moving through the Kitsilano and Fairview area.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 34m; stands (4 spaces) at 46m; stands (4 spaces) at 58m; stands (2 spaces) at 88m; stands (4 spaces) at 97m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates OSM address and phone. The menu page and front page confirm vegan options (Vegan Gyoza, Vegan Tantan Ramen, Vegan Miso Ramen, Vegan Tomato Ramen, Veggie Katsu Set) consistent with OSM diet:vegan=yes. The site shows 'Order Now Pickup 15 min' and 'Order Online' confirming takeout/pickup service. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenity information appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those fields are null.
concerns: OSM name uses lowercase 'bar' ('Ryu Katsu + Ramen bar') while the website consistently uses title case 'Ryu Katsu + Ramen Bar' — minor but worth normalising at editorial review.
Required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are entirely unaddressed by both the website and OSM tags; an in-person or direct-contact verification is needed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is clearly a real, operating restaurant well-suited to touring cyclists (vegan options, fast pickup, busy cycling corridor), but none of the three required WWC criteria — bike parking, water refill, washrooms — can be confirmed from available evidence. On-site verification is needed before a full accreditation listing can be supported.
